rules: Money is integer cents. Months are 1-based. monthly_return_bps is a fixed MONTHLY return, not an annual rate.

Year 1 costs are annual_tuition_cents plus annual_housing_cents. Each subsequent academic year multiplies each prior component by 1 + annual_cost_increase_bps/10000, rounding each component to cents, ties up.
Pay each academic year costs in full at enrollment_month + 12 * academic_year_index. Horizon ends at enrollment_month + 12 * program_years - 1.
Each month: apply growth to opening savings (round to cents, ties up), add the fixed monthly contribution if month < enrollment_month, add scholarships, then pay expenses.
Find the smallest nonnegative whole-cent monthly contribution at or below max_monthly_contribution_cents that never makes savings negative.
If no allowed contribution works, feasible=false and monthly_contribution_cents must equal the cap. Return its projection through its first shortfall.
If feasible, return the full projection through the horizon with first_shortfall_month=0. A failed projection stops at the first negative closing balance. No borrowing or taxes are modeled.
